facts.business: Agarwal Fortune India Limited is engaged in the purchase and trading of raw material of glass items.
facts.related_party_note: Approved related party transactions for FY 2026-27: (a) M/s Agarwal Toughened Glass India Limited - purchase and trading of raw material of glass items up to Rs. 10 Crore; (b) M/s Agarwal Float Glass India Limited - purchase of raw material of glass items up to Rs. 10 Crore; (c) M/s Hardik Glasses - purchase of raw material of glass items up to Rs. 50 Lakhs.
